learned_operation_rule: Collect candidate hrefs before save; use bounded scroll to discover more links; save only observed same-origin links and avoid start_url/exclude_urls.
assumptions_and_limits: Observed documentation links use the .contentstable and .biglink classes; accept same-origin document-like paths from other indexes. Scroll may expose further links. Up to max_items are saved; only same-origin links with nonempty labels are eligible.
